title: Quadplane VTOL Flight-Test Telemetry, PX4 BATT log (4 Sep 2022)
authors: Md Azizul Islam, Md Nur-A-Adam Dony, Mehedi Hasan, S. G. M. Hossain
derived_copy: Copied CSV verbatim; this manifest and summary auditing code are new AeroForge additions
sensor_provenance: Original PX4 v1.7 legacy sdlog2 flight log; instrument calibration not independently authenticated by AeroForge
duration_source: Original author documentation reports ~24.02 minutes log session and ~6 minutes flight; durations cannot be derived independently from this CSV
vehicle_type: hybrid quadplane VTOL (not an AeroForge multirotor reference design)
remarks: No per-row timestamps: no time-based current integral or reliable transient synchronisation
Cumulative discharged mAh and remaining capacity are estimates of the same PX4 controller, not independent calibrated instruments
One externally recorded real-world flight is not a pack-specific independent M15 replay against the AeroForge battery model
Reported sensor units come from the source's data dictionary; AeroForge has not authenticated instrument calibration
